name: bf-company-formation
description: Burkina Faso company formation and entity choice workpaper for the 2026 intake. It separates SARL, ordinary SA and SAS rules, subscription from paid capital, incorporation from RCCM personality, and company accounts approval from tax filing. Use it to prepare articles, contribution evidence, capital payment schedules, the SARL audit threshold test, declaration of existence and beneficial owner tax records. The official OHADA company Act and selected 2026 CGI articles are the sources actually read. National SARL capital exceptions, current CEFORE registration steps, fees, processing times, sector licences and authenticated form boxes remain explicit gaps. It produces a source-cited preparation file, not registration or professional attestation.
